agenda.title: Advanced Stealth Web Scraping
agenda.description: Modern automation tools benchmark — Playwright vs Puppeteer vs Selenium. WAF penetration algorithms, Cloudflare bypass, CAPTCHA handling, Cloudscraper, and proxy infrastructure management.

agenda.title: Continuous Integration & Deployment (CI/CD)
agenda.description: Orchestrating automated pipelines with Jenkins. Full flow: GitHub version control → static code analysis → quality gates with SonarQube.

agenda.title: Containerization & Orchestration
agenda.description: Packaging Django applications with Docker, pushing to Docker Hub, deploying into highly available Kubernetes clusters.

agenda.title: Infrastructure as Code & Operations
agenda.description: Dynamic infrastructure provisioning with Terraform. Real-time pipeline status alerts integrated directly into Slack.

description: Facilitated an intensive technical workshop diving into the architectures of advanced web scraping and robust DevOps pipelines. The workshop focused on practical, high-scale system implementations — helping participants understand both how to navigate complex web security measures stealthily, and how to architect the microservices needed to deploy and scale these systems reliably.
